children: Swiss elevator maker's Q3 revenue grew 5.1% in local currencies, nine-month revenue up 2.6%
EBIT margin for nine months rose to 13.5%, up 100 bps from prior year period
Company's nine-month net profit rose to CHF 852 mln, with margin of 10.4%
Schindler raises 2026 EBIT margin guidance to about 13.5% from about 13%
ORDER INTAKE - Co said Q3 order intake grew 10.3% in local currencies, supporting revenue growth
MARGIN IMPROVEMENT - EBIT margin increased 100 basis points from prior-year period
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 6 "strong buy" or "buy", 10 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the heavy electrical equipment peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Schindler Holding AG is CHF289.50, about 7.3% above its October 21 closing price of CHF269.80
The stock recently traded at 24 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 25 three months ago
